recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-48420 unless OO later decides derivedFrom should restore another non-Observation target profile, which would be a separate substantive change.
issue_request: FHIR-48420 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to relax the Vital Signs Base Profile's derivedFrom restriction so vital signs can derive from non-vital-sign Observations, and to revisit the similar hasMember restriction; the recorded resolution was to remove the derivedFrom constraint and remove MolecularSequence and QuestionnaireResponse as hasMember choices.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in the FHIR-47136 vital signs cleanup commit family rather than in a commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-48420. Commit 983b8c8cd0db5db4a950f98f683904d1100329de replaced hasMember's old QuestionnaireResponse, MolecularSequence, and vitalsigns target profiles with Observation, and replaced derivedFrom's old specific targets with DocumentReference plus Observation.
additional_context: The vitalsigns IG is active in source/igs.xml and includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns, so source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml is in build scope. The FHIR-48420 Jira comment states that FHIR-47136 addressed the issue by relaxing hasMember and derivedFrom to all Observation instances and excluding inapplicable target types. OO Confluence minutes record the FHIR-48420 persuasive motion and change-applied marking; exact Zulip key search found no directly relevant hits.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml constrains Observation.hasMember to Reference(Observation) and Observation.derivedFrom to Reference(DocumentReference or Observation), satisfying the approved resolution without adding redundant prose or modifying generated artifacts.

related_jiras.note: Its vital signs profile cleanup commit applied the reference target-profile changes that satisfy FHIR-48420. It was not separately decided here because its own scope is broader component MustSupport cleanup.
